clause_mapping.support: Canonical usable-memory and original-size terms plus recorded/stated use of བཀོད in gallery source-condition text. Ordinary recorded-in-file paraphrase; no political proclamation term used.
clause_mapping.review_gate: Check naturalness of the size-modifying relative clause and the stative negative བཀོད་མེད in this file context.

clause_mapping.meaning: A size based on the canvas size was not used as a substitute.
clause_mapping.support: The exact based-on dimensional construction occurs in normalization resources; ཚབ་ཏུ occurs in the animation poster replacement sentence, with independent ཚབ lexical evidence.
clause_mapping.review_gate: Confirm that the assembled clause reads as a non-action, not inability, a prohibition or a suggestion.

clause_mapping.meaning: Original SVG size exceeds the limit on Android bitmap dimensions.

clause_mapping.review_gate: Confirm the new nested bitmap-size-limit phrase is idiomatic and unambiguously dimensions rather than bytes.

clause_mapping.support: Existing memory warning after removing only the automatic adverb; independently present in without-resizing/cursor clauses.
clause_mapping.review_gate: No narrowing to shrink, automatic resize or future behavior.

clause_mapping.meaning: In the SVG, an original size that can be used has not been specified.
clause_mapping.support: Independent computing specify predicate, a can-be-used value construction, and exact original-size term; Dzongkha-specific ནང་ལུ / འབད / བཏུབ / མི composition.
clause_mapping.review_gate: Verify relative-clause attachment and negative result-state register; no claim that the full new sentence is quoted from a dictionary.

clause_mapping.meaning: A size made/determined on the basis of the canvas size was not used as a substitute.
clause_mapping.support: Canonical dimensional normalization uses ལུ་གཞི་བཞག་སྟེ; replacement vocabulary is independently attested in DDC and in app animation text; ལག་ལེན་མ་འཐབ is negative past use.
clause_mapping.review_gate: Confirm natural relative-clause composition and that “made on the basis of” does not suggest the canvas itself was resized.

clause_mapping.meaning: Original SVG size exceeds the range of Android bitmap dimensions.
clause_mapping.support: Existing normalized-image-outside-Android-range message and too-large limit warning, with bitmap retained as the existing technical loan.
clause_mapping.review_gate: Verify nested dimension-range phrase and keep file-byte/memory-budget interpretations excluded.

clause_mapping.support: Exact existing negative action after removing only automatic; does not borrow the Tibetan predicate.
